title: Maraal's Last Letter
summary: He died whole. His last words, in the Old Tongue: 'Maraal, it's my fault...' Go home. Tell them.

goals.say: Every bell in every village rings at once, and nobody rang them.
goals.name: Village Elder

quest_book.title: Maraal's Last Letter
quest_book.author: Maraal
pages: If you are reading this, he is dead, all of him, and so am I. My half-life ended with his.
Whether you forgave me or not, you finished what I could not. I am sorry for Ashford. I am sorry for all of it.

It was never your fault. It was mine.

Thank you.

- Maraal, once of the Silver Court

threats.name: Village Elder
threats.target_line: The bells. Did you hear the bells? Every one of them, all at once.
talk: He's dead. The god is dead.
The bells rang on their own. I thought it was the end of the world.
Then sit. Eat. Tell me everything, slowly. I want to remember it right.
